headline: Executive order signed February 18, 2025, about making federal agencies answerable to the President's oversight.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets out steps meant to hold federal agencies accountable, apparently including agencies that usually work with some independence from the White House. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and agencies covered cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The title suggests these agencies may face new oversight or review requirements from the President's office.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 18, 2025; the exact start date for any requirements is not stated in the available material.
